title: Current-runtime Qwen3.5 KleidiAI frontier
hypothesis: A current Apache-2.0 Qwen3.5 4B quantization running through a pinned current llama.cpp and KleidiAI build will clear the unchanged quality floor and the frozen cloud SLOs.
selection_basis: Qwen3.5-4B is the smallest current official Qwen3.5 release with materially stronger published reasoning and instruction-following results than the earlier calibration candidates. Q4_0 and Q8_0 are the two quantizations accelerated by the pinned llama.cpp KleidiAI backend.
controlled_difference: The two candidates use the same source model, prompts, current llama.cpp revision, KleidiAI revision, HTTP chat path, non-thinking template mode, sampling settings, thread count, context, and execution host; weight quantization is the only candidate-level difference.

quality.prediction_parser: first standalone uppercase A-D after case folding
